name: The Giant Snail House in a Glowing Mushroom Forest
description: A cozy, moss-covered snail shell house nestled among giant, bioluminescent mushrooms that glow in vibrant blues and purples in a magical forest at night.
prompt: A cozy, rustic house built into a giant, moss-covered snail shell, nestled among colossal, bioluminescent mushrooms in a magical forest at night. The mushrooms glow in vibrant shades of blue, purple, and turquoise, casting an ethereal light on the mossy ground. Soft, warm light glows from the windows of the snail house. Whimsical, fantasy, highly detailed.
caption: The quiet sanctuary of the forest, resting softly under a canopy of glowing, colorful mushrooms. 🐌🍄
